text:
Bike ride in the sun
Sun on the water, a long bike ride along the coast. The sea was so bright it hurt to look at it, in a good way. I bought a lemonade at the pier and smiled at the seagulls, who were not smiling back.
A light day. The kind you keep in your pocket.
